# Resume — catalyst-dogfood-build

## Resume prompt
> run python3 scripts/handoff-render.py catalyst-dogfood-build and continue. next acceptance check: build Catalyst Tier 2 (evaluator-library + failure-pattern-detector + pipeline-templates) using Catalyst own skills as the harness.

## Summary
- Branch: main
- Written in worktree: /workspace/catalyst
- Done when: Tier 2 v0.5 shipped with all 3 skills passing pass@3 >= 0.90 + handoff v0.3 / Tier 1 regression at pass^3 = 1.00.
- Next acceptance check: Tier 2 v0.5 shipped with all 3 skills passing pass@3 >= 0.90 + handoff v0.3 / Tier 1 regression at pass^3 = 1.00.
- Diff: clean working tree

Decisions:
  - Tier 1 is SHIPPED as v0.4 (live as v0.1.13). Skills: handoff (v0.3), verify-gate (v0.4), hooks (v0.4). All 4 commands work.
  - Next build target: Tier 2 per docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-24-tier-2-orchestration-extensions-design.md
  - Build Catalyst with Catalyst: dogfood catalyst:handoff PIPELINE mode + catalyst:verify-gate + catalyst:hooks install --all
  - EDD ordering per CLAUDE.md: evals BEFORE SKILL.md BEFORE hooks
  - POSIX bash + jq only for hooks (no Python deps)
Rejected paths:
  - tool-output compactor — rtk + caveman cover this layer. Removed from Tier 1 scope mid-session (commit c79e5b3 rationale).
  - Catalyst as Company Brain competitor — saturated ecosystem. Bridge via Tier 3 brain-bridge instead.
  - Generic harness scaffolder — Harness Engineer plugin already ships init/doctor/gc/onboard. Do not compete.
  - Autonomous-loop / /goal replacement — Claude Code platform owns this; wrong shape for Catalyst collaborative-first positioning.
  - Skipping evals — every Tier 1 skill has evals committed BEFORE the SKILL.md per EDD. Tier 2 must follow same rule.
Open risks:
  - Tier 2 failure-pattern-detector overlaps with Tier 3 session-degradation-watch on repeated-tool-call + stale-read signals.
  - Plugin marketplace risk: ClawHavoc (Jan 2026) — skill-supply-chain-audit (Tier 4) has not shipped.
  - Hook portability: macOS date -j vs Linux date -d. Windows native not supported (POSIX bash only).
  - Auto-bump pipeline depends on GitHub Actions firing on push. Has glitched once (commit ecc3408); manual gh workflow run is the escape hatch.

## Files to read first
- docs/ROADMAP.md — 10-skill roadmap, status of each tier, design principles, what-NOT-to-build
- docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-24-tier-2-orchestration-extensions-design.md — Tier 2 spec (what to build next)
- CLAUDE.md — repo conventions (commit format, EDD ordering, skill layout, hook authoring rules)
- docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-24-tier-1-harness-primitives.md — Tier 1 plan as the template for Tier 2 plan structure
- skills/handoff/SKILL.md — handoff v0.3 (4 modes + PIPELINE) — the skill you are about to invoke
- skills/verify-gate/SKILL.md — verify-gate skill — install it before Tier 2 build to enforce evidence discipline
- skills/hooks/SKILL.md — hooks skill — install --all lifecycle hooks for the Tier 2 build sessions
